description: This file contains pyinstaller hook functions and configurations for the kivy framework, including methods to determine dependencies, hook paths, and binary inclusion for packaging.

methods.name: runtime_hooks
methods.description: Returns a list with the runtime hooks for kivy, used in the analysis spec.

methods.name: hookspath
methods.description: Returns the directory path containing the custom pyinstaller hook for kivy.

methods.name: get_hooks
methods.description: Returns a dictionary with hookspath and runtime_hooks for analysis configuration.

methods.name: get_deps_minimal
methods.description: Returns a dictionary of minimal hidden modules, excluded modules, and binaries for packaging, based on specified core modules.

methods.name: get_deps_all
methods.description: Returns a dictionary of all possible kivy modules, including indirect imports, for packaging.

methods.name: get_factory_modules
methods.description: Returns a list of modules registered in the kivy factory.

methods.name: add_dep_paths
methods.description: Adds dependency binary paths to sys.path for pyinstaller to find during analysis.
